# Structuring the Projects Section

#### Course: Learn CSS

## Structuring the Projects Section

As shown in the design, the layout contains one large card on the left and four smaller cards on the right.

- The left card will take more space to stand out as the featured project.
- The right side will contain smaller cards arranged in two rows with two cards per row.

![Idea Emoji](data:image/png;base64,)

```css
1/* Import custom font */
2@import url("https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Euclid+Circular+A:wght@400;500&display=swap");
3
4* {
5    font-family: 'Euclid Circular A', sans-serif;
6    line-height: 1.5;
7}
8
9.projects-grid {
10    display: grid;
11    grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr;
12    grid-template-rows: auto auto;
13    gap: 20px;
14}
15
16/* Style cards */
17.projects-grid > div {
18    background-color: #ffffff;
19    border-radius: 10px;
20    padding: 20px;
21    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
22}
23
24.primary-card {
25    grid-area: 1 / 1 / 3 / 2;
26}
27
28/* Flex layout */
29.tech-tag-list {
30    display: flex;
31    gap: 10px;
32}
33
34/* Style tags */
35.tech-tag-list > div {
36    background-color: #f3f3f3;
37    color: #49497e;
38    font-size: 0.8rem;
39    border-radius: 5px;
40    padding: 4px 4px;
41}
42
43/* Style images */
44img {
45    width: 100%;
46    border-radius: 10px;
47}
48
49/* Style headings */
50h3 {
51    color: #25265e;
52    font-size: 1.5rem;
53    font-weight: 550;
54}
55
56/* Style paragraphs */
57p {
58    font-size: 16px;
59}
60
61/* Style links */
62a {
63    color: #0556f3;
64    font-weight: medium;
65    text-decoration: none;
66}
```

In the above code,

1. .projects-grid: Uses CSS Grid to create a responsive layout with one larger column for the featured project and two smaller columns for the remaining cards.
2. .primary-card: Styled to span two rows, making it larger and more prominent as the featured project.
3. tech-tag-list: Displays the tech stack tags in a flex layout, wrapping as needed on smaller screens.
4. Project Card Styling: Each card has a white background, shadow, and padding, creating a clean, organized look.
5. Responsive Elements: The grid-template-columns and grid-template-rows allow the cards to adjust effectively on different screen sizes.
